z-tabbar.$description: Tab bar stacking; sheets and the player sit above.

z-sheet.$description: Sheet stacking, above the tab bar.

hues.source: Mina §2.5 (opens over the tab bar, z-50)

z-player.$description: MiniPlayer stacking: above the bar, below sheets.

hues.source: Mina §2.6 (z-50, above the bar, below sheets)

z-notice.$description: Update notice stacking: same slot family as the player; the two never stack.

hues.source: Mina §2.7 (same slot family as the player, never stacked)

topbar-height.$description: Phone top bar height above its border.

top-clearance.$description: Content clearance under the phone top bar and game header. The invariant game fit QA measures; it does not move.

tabbar-reservation.$description: Bar clearance for content: bottom padding on main.

hues.source: Mina §2.3 bar clearance; plan §3 tab-bar reservation

scroll-padding-top.$description: AppShell scroll-padding-top: focus never lands under the sticky header.

scroll-padding-bottom.$description: AppShell scroll-padding-bottom: tab-bar reservation plus the MiniPlayer height, measured at runtime by the player component (never a pass-1 figure).

hues.source: Plan §3 (A11y #8); Mina §4.2 reservation re-measures at build
Mina §3 state language (2px ring plus an offset); WCAG 2.4.13 house practice

focus-offset-width.$description: Focus double-signal offset width. UNVERIFIED provisional: the specs name the offset but not its width; symmetric 2px pending ruling (settles with the Mina or Ada seat, or Quinn's rendered check).

hues.source: Mina §3 state language (offset width UNVERIFIED, provisional 2px)

target-min.$description: System target promise: every interactive row states its hit area; undimensioned rows default here. Named exceptions permitted; silent ones are defects.
